summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and then invokes `bun math_init.js` against a ~728 KB obfuscator.io-style file bundled in the package (rotated string array, mangled `_0x...` identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled-bundle header). The package's advertised purpose is a conversation-context helper, which has no legitimate need to ship Bun-compiled code or fetch a second runtime at install time. The obfuscated payload is not Node-resolvable and is not human-readable without execution under the dropped Bun binary. The combination — install-time fetch of a secondary runtime specifically used to execute shipped opaque bundled code that mismatches the package's stated purpose — is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern, executing attacker-controlled code on the installer's host during `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
